featured_reviews.name: Dr Rasika Biswas
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very comfortable stay at the hospital. We were accommodated on the 9th floor and the rooms and facilities were very well maintained. The overall environment was calm and supportive during the stay.

The staff were courteous and helpful throughout. The nursing sisters took very good care of me and were attentive whenever I needed assistance.

The food and general services were also good and well organized.

Overall, the hospital stay was comfortable and the staff made the experience much easier.

featured_reviews.name: Md. Nurealam Siddiqui
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am Dr. Nurealam Siddiqui from Bangladesh. Recently, I was admitted to Jaslok Hospital and Research Center, Mumbai for urgent surgery for a pituitary adenoma under the care of the renowned and highly experienced neurosurgeon Dr. Raghvendra Ramadasi.

I received a very reasonable and transparent treatment package for the surgery. By the grace of Almighty and the expertise of my surgeon, the operation was highly successful and the tumor was completely removed. I am already experiencing significant improvement in my symptoms within a short period of time.

During my stay, Jaslok Hospital provided truly world-class healthcare with exceptional patient care. The management and support from all levels of the hospital staff were highly commendable and professional.

Although I have now been discharged from the hospital, my physician continues to stay in touch with me and regularly monitors my health and recovery.

I found Jaslok Hospital and Research Center to be a highly specialized medical institution equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, providing excellent treatment with justified and transparent costs. I am sincerely grateful to the hospital authorities, my surgeon Dr. Raghvendra Ramadasi, and his dedicated team for the successful surgery and my smooth recovery.

featured_reviews.name: Anurag Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I stayed at Jaslok Hospital & Research Centre for 34 days while undergoing treatment under Dr. Sunil Chopade Sir, along with Dr. Reetu Ma’am , Dr. Gaurav Sir and Dr. Bhat Sir who specialize in Bone Marrow Transplant.
The doctors are highly knowledgeable, supportive, and guided me through every stage of my treatment.
The nursing and support staff are truly amazing and very dedicated to patient care.
They regularly monitor vitals and ensure medications are given on time.
The staff is quick, responsive, and always ready to help whenever needed.
Their attention and compassion made a difficult treatment journey much easier.
The hygiene standards in the hospital are excellent.
My room was cleaned and sanitized twice a day, which helps reduce infection risks.
The rooms are well-equipped and maintained to provide a safe and comfortable environment.
Overall, I am very grateful to the entire team at Jaslok for their exceptional care and support.

featured_reviews.name: Akshit Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the doctor, nursing team, and all supporting staff involved in my knee replacement surgery. From the initial consultation through surgery and recovery, the care I received was excellent.

The doctor was highly professional, knowledgeable, and patient in explaining the procedure, risks, and recovery plan, which gave me great confidence and peace of mind. The surgery went smoothly, and the post-operative follow-up was thorough and reassuring.

The nursing and support staff were exceptional—kind, attentive, and responsive at all times. They ensured my comfort, managed pain effectively, and provided clear guidance for mobility, physiotherapy, and wound care. Their compassion and encouragement made a significant difference in my recovery experience.

The hospital environment was clean, well-organized, and efficient, contributing to a safe and comfortable stay. I truly appreciate the teamwork and dedication shown by everyone involved.

I highly recommend this hospital and medical team to anyone considering knee replacement surgery

Dr. Miten Sheth
Nurse Name : Bhavna Sister

featured_reviews.name: Bigyan Lama
featured_reviews.review_text: My wife first underwent pituitary Cushing’s disease surgery in Nepal, but it was not successful. Later, she had a second surgery at Jaslok Hospital on January 23, 2026, under Dr. Raghvendra Ramdasi. The doctor was highly expert, supportive, and took great care throughout the treatment. The surgery was successful, and she is doing very well now. The hospital staff also provided excellent care and support. We are very satisfied with the overall experience. Thank you to the entire team. Love from Nepal.❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Sane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall excellent service.  Consulting Dr. Basade M. and his team, nurse staff including Chemo treatment staff, all are in tandem. Explanation is clear, next planning is clear so easy for us to follow.
Food is good, time to time. All other ancillary staff is quite helpful and they also interact in nice manner.
As the main building patient rooms are having windows, it is always preferred to get admitted here rather than annexe building.
Rooms are good, comfortable and adequate furniture and fittings.

featured_reviews.name: Tripper Wolf
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst hospital experience and hospitality I have ever seen till now. If you come by bike, there is absolutely no parking facility for you. The hospital only provides parking and valet service for cars, which clearly shows they only care about people who own cars.

When I asked the watchman about bike parking, instead of helping properly, I was misguided and told that there is a nearby BMC parking available. That parking was almost 800 meters away from the hospital, and after going there, I found out that even the BMC parking does not allow bikes to be parked there. This practically means that if you come by bike, you are not welcome at this hospital. It feels like this hospital only gives preference to rich people who have cars, while others are ignored. If you don’t own a car, it is honestly better to visit a government hospital instead.

The second bad experience was with the hospital staff. When I asked about the OPD, the staff simply told me it was on the 3rd floor while I was already standing near the lift. After going upstairs, I realized that the OPD was actually located in another building. They should have clearly informed me that I needed to go to the other building instead of giving incomplete information. Because of this, I had to come back down and walk again to another building unnecessarily.

Zero humanity, zero hospitality, poor management, and no proper guidance for patients or visitors. Extremely disappointing experience.

featured_reviews.name: jatin koli
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good service from all the staff, doctors, nurses, especially Nurse Kumud and two other staff members whose names we unfortunately forgot, as well as the entire team. The treatment provided was excellent, and the care given to the patient was outstanding. Special thanks to the Health Insurance Team, Housekeeping Team, and Pantry Staff for their support, efficiency, and dedication. Overall, it was a very good experience with excellent treatment and patient care. Thank you to everyone for your kindness and professionalism."
